import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int n = 6;
    static final int f = 20;
    static class ModNum {
        static final int MOD = 1000000007;
        int v;

        ModNum() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        ModNum(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0)
                v += MOD;
            this.v = (int) v;
        }

        public static int modinv(int a, int m) {
            if (m == 1)
                return 0;
            a %= m;
            if (a < 0)
                a += m;
            assert a != 0;
            if (a == 1)
                return 1;
            return m - (int) ((long) modinv(m, a) * m / a);
        }

        public ModNum inv() {
            return new ModNum(modinv(this.v, MOD));
        }

        public ModNum add(ModNum o) {
            int res = this.v + o.v;
            if (res >= MOD)
                res -= MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        public ModNum subtract(ModNum o) {
            int res = this.v - o.v;
            if (res < 0)
                res += MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        public ModNum multiply(ModNum o) {
            long res = (long) this.v * o.v % MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        public ModNum divide(ModNum o) {
            return this.multiply(o.inv());
        }

        public static ModNum one() {
            return new ModNum(1);
        }

        public static ModNum zero() {
            return new ModNum(0);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        ModNum[][] p = new ModNum[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(p[i], ModNum.zero());
        }
        int _n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int a = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = new ModNum(a).divide(new ModNum(100));
            }
        }

        int[] maskSizes = {0}; // Placeholder, actual size known after calculations
        // Create masks
        List<Integer>[] masks = new ArrayList[2];
        masks[0] = new ArrayList<>();
        masks[1] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    int mask0 = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                    int mask1 = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask0;
                    masks[0].add(mask0);
                    masks[1].add(mask1);
                }
            }
        }
        assert masks[0].size() == f;

        ModNum[][] sets = new ModNum[2][(1 << f)];
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            Arrays.fill(sets[t], ModNum.zero());
        }

        int halfN = n / 2;
        int totalEdges = halfN * n;

        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int e = 0; e < (1 << totalEdges); e++) {
                ModNum prob = ModNum.one();
                int[] edges = new int[halfN];
                Arrays.fill(edges, 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < totalEdges; i++) {
                    boolean r = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    int row = (i / n) * 2 + t;
                    int col = i % n;
                    ModNum pp = p[row][col];
                    prob = r ? prob.multiply(pp) : prob.multiply(ModNum.one().subtract(pp));
                    edges[i / n] |= (r ? 1 : 0) << (i % n);
                }

                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < masks[t].size(); a++) {
                    int mask = masks[t].get(a);
                    int[] rArr = new int[halfN];
                    for (int i = 0; i < halfN; i++) {
                        rArr[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    }
                    boolean flag = rArr[0] != 0 && rArr[1] != 0 && rArr[2] != 0;
                    if (flag) {
                        int totalPopCount = 0;
                        totalPopCount += Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[1]);
                        totalPopCount += Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[2]);
                        totalPopCount += Integer.bitCount(rArr[1] | rArr[2]);
                        if (totalPopCount >= 6) { // Corrected to match the logic: check for >= 2 in each pair
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(rArr[1] | rArr[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets[t][work_mask] = sets[t][work_mask].add(prob);
            }
        }

        // Inclusion-exclusion sum over sets[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)] = sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)].add(sets[0][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        ModNum ans = ModNum.zero();
        int fullMask = (1 << f) - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j <= fullMask; j++) {
            ModNum term = sets[0][j].multiply(sets[1][fullMask ^ j]);
            ans = ans.add(term);
        }
        ans = ModNum.one().subtract(ans);
        System.out.println(ans.v);
    }
}
